# Actions

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask gen-docs` from the action registry. Do not edit. -->

Every action can be dispatched by name with JSON parameters (`host --stdio`, later the UI, scripts and MCP). The tier is checked on every call; `safety` actions are always allowed.

| Action | Tier | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `console.get` | read | Console rows (sent commands, answers, messages). |
| `job.abort` | safety | Stops streaming the job and sends `M5` (lines already in the board still run; use machine.stop to stop at once). Always allowed. |
| `job.info` | read | The loaded program (name, lines, estimated time, range). |
| `job.load` | edit | Loads and analyzes a G-code file. |
| `job.load_text` | edit | Loads and analyzes G-code given as text. |
| `job.resume` | laser | Runs the loaded program from a position, rebuilding position, power and modes first. Fires the laser. |
| `job.run` | laser | Runs the loaded program from the start (header, program, footer, passes). Fires the laser. |
| `machine.connect` | machine | Connects to the machine on a serial port, or to the built-in emulator. |
| `machine.custom_code` | laser | Runs custom code (buttons, macros): `[expr]` evaluated, immediate characters sent at once. |
| `machine.disconnect` | machine | Closes the connection. |
| `machine.feed_hold` | safety | Feed hold (pause the motion). Always allowed. |
| `machine.home` | machine | Runs the homing cycle (`$H`). |
| `machine.jog` | machine | Jogs one step in a direction (laser off). |
| `machine.jog_stop` | safety | Stops a continuous jog. Always allowed. |
| `machine.jog_to` | machine | Jogs to a work position (laser off). |
| `machine.list_ports` | read | Serial ports found on this computer. |
| `machine.overrides` | machine | Sets the override targets; the host steps the board towards them. |
| `machine.read_settings` | machine | Reads the board settings again (`$$`). |
| `machine.resume` | machine | Resumes after a feed hold or a door (cycle start). |
| `machine.safety_door` | safety | Safety door (real-time 0x84): the board holds as if its door opened; resume with machine.resume. Always allowed. |
| `machine.select_laser` | edit | Selects the laser module in use (life counters). |
| `machine.send` | laser | Sends one line of G-code or a `$` command (not during a job). It can turn the laser on. |
| `machine.set_zero` | machine | Sets the current position as work zero (`G92 X0 Y0 Z0`). |
| `machine.stop` | safety | STOP: soft reset of the board (laser off, queues flushed). Always allowed. |
| `machine.unlock` | machine | Unlocks the alarm state (`$X`). |
| `machine.write_settings` | machine | Writes board settings (`$N=V`), one at a time; returns when the board answered all of them. |
| `settings.get` | read | Reads the settings (all, or one dotted key). |
| `settings.set` | edit | Changes one setting and saves the file. Automation settings are user-only and refused here. |
| `state.get` | read | Machine state, loaded program, issues and resume offer. |
| `view.close_dialog` | ui | Closes a dialog (the one on top when none is given). |
| `view.dismiss_toast` | ui | Removes a toast. |
| `view.fit` | ui | Fits the work area in the canvas. |
| `view.focus` | ui | Records which element has the keyboard focus. |
| `view.get` | read | The view state: mode, panel, dialogs, toasts, viewport, focus. |
| `view.open_dialog` | ui | Opens a dialog on top of the others (dialogs are not modal: STOP stays reachable). |
| `view.set_drawer` | ui | Opens or closes the panel drawer (medium layout). |
| `view.set_mode` | ui | Switches between the Design and Produce modes. |
| `view.set_viewport` | ui | Shows the table around a point at a zoom (CSS pixels per mm). |
| `view.show_panel` | ui | Shows a panel of the dock (opens the drawer in the medium layout). |
| `view.toast` | ui | Shows a short message (at most 3 at once); returns its id. |

## Parameters

### `console.get`

Console rows (sent commands, answers, messages).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `last` | no | Only the last `last` rows. |

### `job.abort`

Stops streaming the job and sends `M5` (lines already in the board still run; use machine.stop to stop at once). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `job.info`

The loaded program (name, lines, estimated time, range).

No parameters.

### `job.load`

Loads and analyzes a G-code file.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | Path of a G-code file. |

### `job.load_text`

Loads and analyzes G-code given as text.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gcode` | yes | The G-code. |
| `name` | yes | Name shown for the program. |

### `job.resume`

Runs the loaded program from a position, rebuilding position, power and modes first. Fires the laser.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `homing` | no | Home first. |
| `position` | yes | 0-based index of the first command to run. |
| `set_wco` | no | Restore the work offset of the interrupted job. |

### `job.run`

Runs the loaded program from the start (header, program, footer, passes). Fires the laser.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `homing` | no | Home (`$H`) before the job. |
| `passes` | no | Number of passes (default 1). |

### `machine.connect`

Connects to the machine on a serial port, or to the built-in emulator.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baud` | no | Baud rate; default: from the settings (115200). |
| `emulator` | no | Connect to the built-in emulator instead of a serial port. |
| `port` | no | Serial port (`/dev/ttyUSB0`, `COM3`); default: the last one used. |

### `machine.custom_code`

Runs custom code (buttons, macros): `[expr]` evaluated, immediate characters sent at once.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | yes | Lines of custom code (`[expr]`, `!`, `~`, `?`, `ctrl-x`, `0xNN` allowed). |

### `machine.disconnect`

Closes the connection.

No parameters.

### `machine.feed_hold`

Feed hold (pause the motion). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.home`

Runs the homing cycle (`$H`).

No parameters.

### `machine.jog`

Jogs one step in a direction (laser off).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | yes | `N`, `S`, `E`, `W`, `NE`, `NW`, `SE`, `SW`, `Zup`, `Zdown` or `Home`. |
| `feed_mm_min` | no | Feed in mm/min (default: the jog setting). |
| `step_mm` | no | Step in mm (default: the jog setting). |

### `machine.jog_stop`

Stops a continuous jog. Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.jog_to`

Jogs to a work position (laser off).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed_mm_min` | no | Feed in mm/min (default: the jog setting). |
| `x` | yes | Target X (work coordinates, mm). |
| `y` | yes | Target Y (work coordinates, mm). |

### `machine.list_ports`

Serial ports found on this computer.

No parameters.

### `machine.overrides`

Sets the override targets; the host steps the board towards them.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed` | yes | Feed override target, % (10-200). |
| `power` | yes | Power override target, % (10-200). |
| `rapid` | yes | Rapid override target, % (25, 50 or 100). |

### `machine.read_settings`

Reads the board settings again (`$$`).

No parameters.

### `machine.resume`

Resumes after a feed hold or a door (cycle start).

No parameters.

### `machine.safety_door`

Safety door (real-time 0x84): the board holds as if its door opened; resume with machine.resume. Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.select_laser`

Selects the laser module in use (life counters).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of the laser life counter. |

### `machine.send`

Sends one line of G-code or a `$` command (not during a job). It can turn the laser on.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | yes | One line of G-code or a `$` command. |

### `machine.set_zero`

Sets the current position as work zero (`G92 X0 Y0 Z0`).

No parameters.

### `machine.stop`

STOP: soft reset of the board (laser off, queues flushed). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.unlock`

Unlocks the alarm state (`$X`).

No parameters.

### `machine.write_settings`

Writes board settings (`$N=V`), one at a time; returns when the board answered all of them.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settings` | yes | Values by setting number (`{"110": "6000"}`). |

### `settings.get`

Reads the settings (all, or one dotted key).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | no | Dotted key (`machine.baud`); all settings when absent. |

### `settings.set`

Changes one setting and saves the file. Automation settings are user-only and refused here.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | yes | Dotted key (`machine.streaming_mode`). `automation.*` is user-only. |
| `value` | yes | New value (JSON). |

### `state.get`

Machine state, loaded program, issues and resume offer.

No parameters.

### `view.close_dialog`

Closes a dialog (the one on top when none is given).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dialog` | no | The dialog; the one on top when absent. |

### `view.dismiss_toast`

Removes a toast.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id returned by `view.toast`. |

### `view.fit`

Fits the work area in the canvas.

No parameters.

### `view.focus`

Records which element has the keyboard focus.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | no | Element with the focus (`canvas`, `console`...), none when absent. |

### `view.get`

The view state: mode, panel, dialogs, toasts, viewport, focus.

No parameters.

### `view.open_dialog`

Opens a dialog on top of the others (dialogs are not modal: STOP stays reachable).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dialog` | yes | The dialog. |

### `view.set_drawer`

Opens or closes the panel drawer (medium layout).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | yes | Open or closed. |

### `view.set_mode`

Switches between the Design and Produce modes.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | yes | `design` or `produce`. |

### `view.set_viewport`

Shows the table around a point at a zoom (CSS pixels per mm).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cx` | yes | Centre X, mm. |
| `cy` | yes | Centre Y, mm. |
| `scale` | yes | Zoom, CSS pixels per mm. |

### `view.show_panel`

Shows a panel of the dock (opens the drawer in the medium layout).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | yes | `layers`, `object`, `machine` or `console`. |

### `view.toast`

Shows a short message (at most 3 at once); returns its id.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `args` | no | Placeholders of the message. |
| `level` | no | `info` (default), `ok`, `warning` or `error`. |
| `message` | yes | i18n key (or plain text). |
